items.title: Marty Morell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: I did a lot of dates and sessions with Sammy. ... he always asked for me in the rhythm section

ctx.x: I was going to say boy, you played with him and you played with Don Sebesky, who is one of my favorite writers. Cool.
Yeah. I did a lot of dates with, we’re playing one of his charts, Sammy Nestico.
